messages.subject: MIMIC model or multigroup CFA
parts:
Hello, Sir!

This is Eaindray again. Sorry for frequent questions.

I would like to know which model is the best suited for comparison.

I would like to compare the service quality of 3 bus lines.
The questionnaire is in 5-point likert scale, 24 variables.
I've run EFA for each bus line separately and got 3 latent factors for all bus lines (luckily the same factors).
As for variables, 16, 16 and 14 variables for 3 bus lines.

May I know which model is the best one to evaluate the good bus line and the bad bus line?
Thank you very much.

Sincerely,
Eaindray
